{{Quote|I've been waiting for a moment like this...|A Terror Trooper before engaging Starkiller on the ''Salvation''|<ref name="TFUIIvg" />}}
'''Terror Troopers''' were an experimental class of elite [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]. Shortly after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] began with the founding of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dispatched several of these [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to assist the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] mission to capture [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].

==History==
{{Quote|I'll need a squadron of stormtroopers. They won't be coming back.''"<br />"''The Empire will provide whatever you require.''"<br />"''They'll do.|Boba Fett and Darth Vader, during the Bounty Hunter's introduction to the Terror Troopers|<ref name="TFUIIvg" />}}
The Terror Troopers were created as [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] experiments conducted by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]].<ref name="TFUIIvg" /> Their [[Helmet/Legends|masks]] resembled [[Kaleesh mask/Legends|those worn]] by the long-[[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

Shortly after the start of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the Terror Troopers were deployed on their first known mission after a [[Subject 1138|renegade clone]] of the late [[Galen Marek]] escaped from the [[Timira City]] [[Cloning/Legends|Cloning Facility]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. In response, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] charged [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] with luring Starkiller back to him. Despite the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] exceptional skills, Vader thought that Fett would not likely survive an encounter with his former apprentice's clone. Thus, he redirected Fett to finding [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] so that she could be brought to Kamino, knowing that Starkiller would follow. Although Fett requested a squadron of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to assist him in Eclipse's capture, Vader was willing to grant the mercenary far more than he requested. Satisfied with his backup, Fett began his search for Eclipse with the Terror Troopers, including [[Terror Biodroid]]s, [[Terror Droid]]s and one [[Terror Walker]].<ref name="TFUIIvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

[[File:Terror_Trooper_Starkiller.png|thumb|left|250px|A Terror Trooper attacks Starkiller.]]
Shortly after learning the location of Captain Eclipse's starship, the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']], Boba Fett ordered his forces to [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|attack]] the Rebel frigate, much to the relief of the [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilots]] who feared the Terror Troopers. After successfully infiltrating the ''Salvation'', Fett ordered several Terror Troopers to escort him to the bridge. However, Starkiller and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] had also just arrived in the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'' and were heading to the ''Salvation''. Before storming the bridge, Fett instructed the Terror Troopers to use caution when fighting Starkiller, warning them about how the clone's [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] was liable to disrupt their onboard systems.<ref name="TFUIIc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref>

After making their way to the bridge, the Terror Troopers easily killed the bridge crew, sparing only Captain Eclipse as per Vader's orders.<ref name="TFUIIc" /> As Fett escorted his prisoner to [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], the Terror Troopers remained on the ''Salvation'' to stall Starkiller long enough for Fett to escape with Eclipse. Although they utilized all of their combative abilities against Starkiller, they were ultimately no match against the clone's skills. Despite the fact that none of the Terror Troopers were able to defeat Starkiller or last very long against him, they nevertheless succeeded in buying Fett just enough time to reach ''Slave I'' with Eclipse before traveling to Kamino.<ref name="TFUIIvg" />

Although he failed to prevent Fett from escaping with Eclipse, Starkiller eliminated the remaining Terror Troopers aboard the ''Salvation''. After Starkiller used Eclipse's Rebel frigate to penetrate Kamino's planetary shields, General Kota's Rebel forces [[Assault on Kamino|assaulted]] Timira City. The Terror Troopers fought alongside the planet's Imperial forces in defense of the cloning facility, only to be annihilated by Starkiller as he pressed on towards the city's top spire where Vader held Eclipse captive. Despite the considerable military force that protected Kamino, the Terror Troopers and the rest of the Imperial garrison failed to prevent the Alliance from winning the battle and capturing Darth Vader in the process.<ref name="TFUIIvg" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|We will tear you apart&hellip;|Terror Trooper engaging Starkiller|<ref name="TFUIIvg" />}}
[[File:Terrortroopers.png|thumb|left|150px|A Terror Trooper standing over a pile of wreckage.]]
The Terror Troopers possessed a [[Stun blaster/Legends|Stun blaster]] of some sort. They also appeared to have a cloaking ability similar to that of the [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Trooper]] and incredible agility which allowed them to dodge most melee attacks. Due to their fast reflexes and stealth capabilities, the Terror Troopers were sent into hostile environments in order to quickly dispose of targets without leaving a trace. Interestingly, the Terror Trooper was visible using force sight, even when cloaked.

They were also specialized in direct combat via their sharpened, [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] talons on their hands and feet, and their strength, speed, and agility were augmented via their [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. Their Grievous-like masks provided augmented respiration for the trooper's augmented and organic lungs.

==Behind the scenes==
The Terror Troopers' helmets resemble the faceplate of General Grievous, while the tips of the boots resemble his talons. The chest [[Armor/Legends|armor]], codpiece, and knee pads are similar in appearance to those of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] armor. The metal [[Claw/Legends|claws]] on the hands resemble clawed fingers of the [[Sith stalker armor]].
The Terror Trooper also shows a close resemblance to the [[Clone assassin]], both attacking and dodging in the same technique.
